name: Chat system
ownerWords:
(10-19) your NUMBER 1 GOAL. this is your "Chat system duty" ... plan should be tasks all eventually clear. duties are things that need constant montiroing thus set a heartbeat. things like "i need to keep X working" should NOT be registered as a zombie plan. ALL PLANS SHOULD BE EPHEMERAL, and the Chat (and Chat-check-in) MUST BE DESIGNED SO THAT IT ACTIVELY PERSUES AND CLEARS ALL THE TASKS. ... keeping this compliant on it's own your duty.

(10-14, c64) this is your KPI of chat system duty. look i know there are alot of checks but the fundamentals are much more important than the quantitative number of checks

(10-15, c75) why is duties not all passing? this should not be considered ok, same for ALL other chats.
goal: Every chat clears its plan on its own and keeps its duties green. The owner checks this by opening a few chats: each open step has a job moving it or a For you question that links it, each plan holds only tasks that finish, and each red duty has a fix job working on it. It runs every 30 min, because the owner asked on 10-15 for a 30-minute check of open steps in all chats, which the Whole system duty held until 10-19. Each run also spot-audits one chat at random, quietly, for now (owner msg mvfb7zt0: "당분간은 몰래 실사 감시도 하고").

metrics.label: Open steps in all chats that nobody moves
Open plan items in all chats that hold upkeep or a standing risk, or a goal with no done line
Red duties in any chat with no live fix job after 3 runs

onMiss: Read the detail file the flagged lines name first. Stuck steps: message each chat that owns them with the step ids and ask it to give each one a live job, a For you todo that links it, or a close, this turn. Plan upkeep: message the chat with the item ids and ask it to move each upkeep or risk item into a duty metric or its wiki risk page and give each open step a Done when line, following the board skill's plan-and-duties reference; when the same chat repeats it on 3 runs, fix the chat brief or check-in prompt that let it through, with a clean-room test. Stuck duties: each gets one fix job, as in the check-ins reference item 12: steer the live job on its fix step, else start one with rlm.create_session and set it on the step. Duties green: the stuck duties come first, and the share needs no separate job. Every run, on target or not: do the spot audit the detail file names, fix what is off in that chat, and append what you found to the log it names. A miscount gets a fix in scripts/duties/chat-system.ts with a test. Never send anything outside, and never message the owner about this duty.
